2773.body:
One of Sugar Skull Cash's top prizes was claimed two days ago. A player in Texas won $100,000. The game started with four top prizes and now has two top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

If you play "Sugar Skull Cash" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" just reached Texas stores with four top prizes of $250,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

The numbers for "The Price is Right™" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
